scenarios.name: text-35 Accept mixed fields with two-decimal model precision

scenario_steps.name: the filename property remains in the fresh editor
the user selects Parameters - Model and inspect Precision
zero through eight decimal examples are offered
the user chooses the two-decimal example
the user focuses the editor, move to its end, press Return, and insert d0
the user accepts Format Text and press Escape
the current document filename and 10.00 remain in separate paragraphs at Ready
the earlier linked Text still displays 10.000
